order: Build the alias layer and the roster kill switch before any rename. In the aliases file, declare every retired name's role and rung pair, plus the legacy identity it keeps while the old roster is installed and its ledger deprecation line. Have the seat resolver evaluate the roster flag per order, so legacy returns the installed legacy agent unchanged while new goes through the casting tables and the degradation machine. The declarative default sits at legacy as the kill-switch home position, so rollback is a flag flip with no reload. Load the map under the same fail-closed discipline the other tables get. An unknown role, a rung the named role does not have, a missing legacy identity or a bad roster default must each refuse construction. Old-name orders dispatch under both flag values, the flip is demonstrated mid-session on one instance, every retired-name resolution emits its deprecation line, and a tampered map fails the load closed.
claims: The aliases map declares 16 retired names with role, rung, identity and deprecation line. The resolver reads the flag per order, so rollback is a flag flip. Old-name orders dispatch under both flag values, flipped mid-session on one instance. The map loads fail-closed on an unknown role or a rung the named role does not have. Section twelve hands a tampered map whose alias names a rung its role lacks, and construction refuses, with the suite finishing green at 93 passed.
